description: This Java class 'DtdTestValidator' is designed to validate XML configuration files against their DTDs, using SAX parser with custom error handling to determine validity.

classes.name: DtdTestValidator
classes.description: Utility class providing a static method to validate XML files against DTDs using SAX parser validation.

methods.name: isValidConfigXml
methods.description: Validates an XML provided via InputStream against its DTD, returning true if valid, false otherwise.
